We're looking for a Lead Director of Software Engineering who thinks like a founder, executes like a

principal engineer, and leads like someone who's done it at the highest levels of the industry. You will

set the bar — and then raise it.

Drive technical strategy across a multi-team engineering organization (50–150+ engineers),

10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading large-

Proven AI platform ownership. You have deployed production AI systems - not POCs, not

Direct and manage the daily activities of the Network and Data Center teams

Graphcore is a global leader in artificial intelligence computing systems. We design advanced semiconductors and data center hardware that deliver the specialized processing power needed to advance AI while improving the efficiency required for broad adoption.

As part of SoftBank Group, Graphcore belongs to a family of companies developing some of the world's most transformative technologies. Our AI Engineering Campus in Austin plays an important role in building the future of AI computing.

The Opportunity

As Technical Services Director, you will lead the teams that operate and evolve Graphcore's engineering labs, high-performance computing (HPC) platforms, and data center environments globally. You will be accountable for reliable, secure, cost-effective infrastructure that supports demanding engineering, AI, silicon-development, and validation workloads.

This role combines people leadership, infrastructure strategy, operational excellence, capacity and financial planning, procurement, and program delivery. You will partner with Engineering, Information Technology, Security, Finance, Facilities, Supply Chain, customers, and external suppliers. The position is based onsite in Austin and requires travel to company facilities, data centers, and supplier locations, including international travel.

Own the reliability, efficiency, protection, safety, supportability, and continuous improvement of engineering labs, HPC systems, and infrastructure facilities.

“I can succeed as the Senior Manager, AI Client Enablement Platform at Capital Group.”

The Senior Manager, AI Client Enablement Platform owns the shared AI capabilities that power Capital Group’s suite of AI-enabled products for our Global Client teams. This role defines the Enablement Intelligence Platform — the reusable intelligence that turns Client data into scoring and coverage intelligence, meeting-prep context, follow-up and CRM-capture services, engagement signals, and the marketing orchestration, retrieval, guardrails, and evaluation standards behind them — so every AI-enabled product builds on it. It is a business-facing product leadership role: you define business requirements, value, product architecture, builder experience, and priorities, and you partner with engineering, architecture, product management, and data science to build it safely, consistently, and at scale.

You own the platform, its shared capabilities, and the roadmap for a suite of AI client products and the sales & marketing experiences they power — products that help decide who to engage, how to prepare, and what to do next. Much of this capability is delivered through our multi-year program to transform Sales & Marketing Enablement experiences and products.

You will use Capital Group’s proprietary insights, client relationships, and enterprise data to create client enablement products that are differentiated and trusted. The role requires strong experience building AI-first products and platforms, practical fluency with Salesforce or enterprise CRM, Adobe Experience Cloud, and the ability to influence and align partners across a complex organization.

What you will build

The Enablement Intelligence Platform: the shared AI capabilities — scoring and coverage intelligence, meeting-prep context, follow-up and CRM-capture services, engagement signals, and the orchestration, retrieval, and guardrails behind them — that all AI-enabled products reuse.
A suite of AI products that help decide who to engage, how to prepare, and what to do next.
Reusable capabilities — including governed data and content services, orchestration patterns, model and workflow integrations, and builder-facing tools — that compound across products, channels, and client segments.

“I am the person Capital Group is looking for.”

AI Platform & Product Leadership

Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Client Enablement Intelligence Platform and the AI seller-assist products and sales experiences it powers.
Provide the shared AI capabilities as governed, reusable services rather than one-off features rebuilt in each product.
Define the product architecture for the platform, including orchestration patterns, reusable AI services, governed data and content services, model and workflow integrations, and the builder experience required for teams to build safely and consistently.
Sequence the platform-first mandate: establish the core capabilities first, then the sales experiences built on them.
Determine where automation, agents, and human judgment should combine to create the greatest value, and set standards for how AI experiences behave across products.
Translate AI opportunities into practical product use cases, experiments, evaluation criteria, launch plans, monitoring routines, and measurable outcomes.
Make informed trade-offs across business value, user needs, platform investment, delivery capacity, AI opportunity, and operational risk when setting priorities.

Product Management & Delivery

Align with business partners on the outcomes that matter and translate them into clear product direction, requirements, and measurable results.
Lead discovery, experimentation, and validation so the team builds the right capabilities before committing to build.
Author clear product requirements that map pain-points to platform features and workflows, and keep data flowing cleanly across products so sellers get one unified experience.
Own launch readiness, adoption, training, and communications, and measure success in Capital Group terms — meeting-prep time saved, engagement quality, coverage, and adoption across teams.
Establish success measures for platform health, builder adoption, AI adoption, experience quality, and business performance, using those insights to inform roadmap decisions and continuous improvement.
Partner with Legal, Risk, and Compliance so client-data use and generative content strictly align with financial-services requirements.

People & Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner closely with the Insights, Analytics, and Data Science teams, and the broader product organization on shared solutions and experiences.
Frame strategies, target metrics, and evaluation criteria.
Serve as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams, building alignment without relying on direct authority.
Communicate strategy, priorities, roadmap, and results to leaders and stakeholders to support informed decisions and organizational alignment.
Foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that encourages accountability, strong product craft, design taste, responsible experimentation, and continuous learning.

Required

Skills & Qualifications

10+ years of product management, including platform product management — building shared, reusable capabilities that other teams build on.
Strong experience building AI-first products and platforms — generative AI, agents and copilots, prompt and retrieval techniques, and evaluation.
Practical fluency with Salesforce or enterprise CRM capabilities, Adobe, and a strong understanding of enterprise client workflows and systems of record.
Strong product judgment and design taste, with the ability to distinguish good from great experiences and raise the bar for usability, trust, accessibility, and end-to-end experience quality.
Experience defining AI evaluation, monitoring, feedback, and governance practices that help teams test, launch, learn from, and scale AI-enabled capabilities responsibly.
Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder influence — leading across Business, Platform, Engineering, Data Science, and Insights & Analytics.
Excellent communication and collaboration, with a natural ability to align cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong influencing skills — able to rationalize, challenge, and prioritize to drive group decisions.
Curiosity, humility, and a collaborative, team-first approach consistent with Capital Group’s culture.

Preferred

Software, Technology, Financial services, asset management, or wealth management experience.
Familiarity with data governance, security, responsible-AI practices, and financial-services compliance and resilience for enterprise platforms.

Employment Eligibility & Verification

All applicants must be able to provide proof of eligibility to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of the I-9 form, as required by federal law. Additionally, candidates will be required to undergo an employment verification process before beginning work. Please note that we do not offer sponsorship for work authorization (e.g., H-1B, TN, or other visas) at this time.

Working Conditions

This role is based on-site at the Fort Myers, Florida headquarters in a collaborative, hands-on engineering environment.
The position will require regular interaction with engineering, manufacturing, service, sales, customers, vendors, and senior leadership.
Domestic travel to customer, vendor, or company sites may be required based on business needs.
International travel may be required approximately 2 to 3 times per year to support international customers, projects, product reviews, or field support activities.

Physical Requirements

The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk and stoop, or crouch. The employee may need to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
